home.title: A place to belong.
home.intro: Good company. A little calm. A shared purpose. Meet a community where different backgrounds and generations come together — and your first visit starts with a simple hello.
home.welcomeTitle:
Come as you are.
Find your place.
home.welcomeBody:
We are a London-based community guided by spiritual values and a shared care for others. Through reflection, learning and practical support, we make room for connection across generations and backgrounds.

Whether you are curious about the Burhaniya path, looking for community, or ready to lend a hand, there is a place to begin.

community.title:
Different journeys.
A shared sense of belonging.
community.intro: A community grows through the care we offer each other. Ours brings spiritual reflection and everyday compassion together.
community.body:
Al Burhaniya UK is a London-based charity with a commitment to education, wellbeing, practical support and community life. Our spiritual values guide how we meet one another: with compassion, dignity and a willingness to listen.

Our work connects generations and backgrounds, supporting people facing hardship and creating opportunities to learn, contribute and belong. The Burhaniya tradition gives us a foundation for reflection; our shared humanity gives that reflection a purpose in everyday life.

programmes.title:
Care that reaches
beyond a gathering.
programmes.intro: From time spent listening to practical help in moments of hardship, our work is rooted in care for the whole person.
programmes.body: Our areas of work bring together learning, wellbeing, cultural connection and practical support. Contact us to discuss current opportunities, availability and how you can take part.

gatherings.title:
Make room
for a shared moment.
gatherings.intro: Discover ways to meet the community, explore spiritual reflection and take part in everyday acts of service.
gatherings.body: The gathering types below introduce ways to get involved. Dates and attendance arrangements are to be confirmed with the team. We will publish the event calendar here when details are available.

stories.title:
Small moments.
Meaningful connections.
stories.intro: A place for reflections, first-visit guides and the everyday ideas that bring our community together.
stories.body: Start with these introductory guides. Community news and approved stories can be added by the team as the website develops.

wellbeing.title:
Space to pause.
Room to reconnect.
wellbeing.intro: Spiritual wellbeing can begin with a quiet moment, a thoughtful conversation, or the reassurance of being among people who care.
wellbeing.body:
Our spiritual tradition offers an invitation to reflection, remembrance and compassionate living. You can ask about gatherings, explore the path at your own pace, or speak with the team about the support you are looking for.

Participation is a personal choice. You are welcome to ask questions before visiting and to let us know about any access needs or concerns.

get-involved.title:
There is more than
one way to give.
get-involved.intro: Your time, skills and generosity can help create opportunities for connection and practical care.
get-involved.body: You might help with a community activity, offer a skill, support practical outreach or ask about a donation. We would love to hear what you can bring and help you find a suitable way to contribute.

contact.title:
A conversation
is a good beginning.
contact.intro: Planning a first visit, asking about an activity, or offering a helping hand? Get in touch and we will help you find the right next step.
contact.body: Please contact us before travelling to confirm current gathering times, visiting arrangements and any accessibility requirements. We want your first visit to feel straightforward and welcoming.

programmes.title: Reflection & spiritual wellbeing
programmes.summary: Time to pause, explore your questions and reconnect with what matters.
programmes.body:
Our community brings spiritual reflection into everyday life through remembrance, conversation and a shared commitment to compassionate living.

You can ask about the Burhaniya tradition and gatherings without feeling that you need to arrive with all the answers. Contact us to discuss how to take part.

programmes.title: Learning & personal growth
programmes.summary: Encouragement, education and skills that help people move forward.
programmes.body:
Learning is one way we support individuals, families and young people. Our focus is on opening opportunities to grow in confidence, build skills and explore new possibilities.

Ask the team about current educational activities, available support and ways to contribute your knowledge.

programmes.title: Practical community support
programmes.summary: Care expressed through everyday help for people facing hardship.
programmes.body:
Our commitment to poverty relief is grounded in dignity and human connection. Practical support and outreach help us respond to hardship and connect people with a caring community.

Speak with the team about current needs, volunteering opportunities and appropriate ways to give.

programmes.title: Culture, creativity & connection
programmes.summary: Shared experiences that bring generations and backgrounds closer.
programmes.body:
Community life is enriched when people can share their creativity, stories and traditions. Cultural and youth activities offer opportunities to connect, develop confidence and build a shared sense of belonging.

Contact us for current activities and ways that families, young people and volunteers can get involved.

programmes.title: Listening & pastoral support
programmes.summary: A compassionate conversation when you need space to be heard.
programmes.body:
Sometimes the first step is simply being able to talk. Our community values listening, moral support and spiritual wellbeing, with respect for the circumstances of each person.

Please contact the team to discuss what support is available and whether it is suitable for your needs. Spiritual or pastoral support does not replace professional healthcare.

programmes.title: Belonging & inclusion
programmes.summary: Building connections for people experiencing isolation or vulnerability.
programmes.body:
A supportive community makes room for people whose circumstances may leave them feeling disconnected. Our values include care for refugees and vulnerable communities, with respect for dignity and individual needs.

Speak with us about current community opportunities, support and ways to help.

gatherings.title: A first visit to the community
gatherings.summary: Meet the community, ask questions and find out how to take part.
gatherings.body:
Interested in visiting? Let us know a little about what brings you here, and the team can explain the next opportunity to join us.

You do not need previous experience of the Burhaniya tradition. Please confirm the date, venue and visiting arrangements with us before travelling.

gatherings.title: Reflection & remembrance
gatherings.summary: Explore spiritual reflection in a thoughtful, welcoming setting.
gatherings.body:
Ask about opportunities for shared remembrance and spiritual reflection. The team can explain what to expect and help you decide whether a gathering is right for you.

The schedule and attendance arrangements will be confirmed directly with you.

gatherings.title: Find your way to contribute
gatherings.summary: Discover how your time and skills could support community activities.
gatherings.body:
Tell us about your interests, skills and availability. The team can discuss current volunteering opportunities and any checks, training or practical arrangements needed for the role.

An enquiry does not commit you to volunteering or reserve a place at an event.

stories.title: Your first visit: a gentle guide
stories.summary: A few simple things to know before you come along.
stories.body:
## Begin with a conversation
If you are thinking about visiting, contact the team first. We can confirm the next gathering, explain the arrangements and answer your questions.

## There is no need to know everything
Curiosity is a good place to start. You can ask about the Burhaniya tradition, what happens at a gathering and how you might participate.

## Tell us what would help
Let us know about any access needs, practical concerns or questions before you travel. Confirm the venue and timings directly with the team.

## Take your time
Finding a community is personal. Give yourself room to listen, reflect and decide what feels right for you.

stories.title: Compassion begins in everyday life
stories.summary: Small acts of care can be the beginning of stronger connections.
stories.body:
## Make space to listen
A thoughtful conversation can help someone feel less alone. Listening with patience is one way to make care part of everyday life.

## Begin with what you can offer
Time, practical help and a willingness to learn can all be valuable contributions. A community grows through many different kinds of generosity.

## Keep dignity at the centre
Helping is also about respect. Approach others as people with their own choices, experiences and strengths.

## Find a shared next step
If you would like to contribute to community activities, speak with our team about current opportunities and the support available to volunteers.

stories.title: Making a little room for reflection
stories.summary: A pause in a busy day can create space for a more thoughtful next step.
stories.body:
## A moment to pause
Reflection does not have to begin with a complicated practice. It can start with a little space to notice what is on your mind and what matters to you.

## Connection as well as quiet
Spiritual wellbeing can be explored in conversation and community, as well as in moments of quiet. It is a personal journey, with room for questions.

## Ask about the tradition
If you would like to learn about the Burhaniya path, contact us. The team can explain opportunities for reflection and remembrance.

## Choose support that fits
Spiritual reflection can be meaningful alongside everyday practical support. If you need medical or mental health care, seek advice from an appropriate healthcare professional.
